title: A logarithmic-volume identity and zero-angular-momentum obstruction
exact_target: Determine whether a four-body orbit can maintain a positive tetrahedron volume uniformly bounded above and below forever.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002548 (AIM-PHYSICS-0056). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 19.

status_qualification: Forever must specify one or both directions of time and exclude breakdown by collision.
